item.title: Trump Suggests Renaming Strait of Hormuz After Himself
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday proposed renaming the Strait of Hormuz to the "Trump Strait," referring to the vital shipping route.

item.title: Canada's Latest Setback: Millions in Contracts to Iran VP's Son
Abdul El-Sayed Called 'Veteran' by Soros-Linked Paper Distributed in Michigan
item.description: A newspaper funded by George Soros incorrectly described Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed as a veteran in a statewide headline.

item.title: Cruz Warns of 'Dangerous Point': China Fueling AI Data Center Opposition
item.description: Senator Ted Cruz of Texas says China is helping drive resistance to AI data centers in the U.S., calling it a serious concern.
